subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should this focused workspace breadcrumb be ported onto the current dashboard chrome, or should persistent multi-agent workspace context wait for a different no-breadcrumb/header design?
rationale: The branch is now stale against a merged chrome redesign, and another open maintainer draft proposes removing breadcrumbs, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent header contract.

options.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
options.body: Keep the focused scope, port it to the current `ui/src/app` and `ui/src/components` header paths, refresh browser proof, and leave optional UX ideas separate.

options.title: Wait For No-Breadcrumb Direction
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether a no-breadcrumb or sidebar-based design should carry persistent agent/workspace context.

options.title: Broaden Before Landing
options.body: Require the implementation to cover stronger switch feedback or live-target proof before treating the linked issue as closable.

recommendation.title: Port Focused Breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Keep the focused scope, port it to the current `ui/src/app` and `ui/src/components` header paths, refresh browser proof, and leave optional UX ideas separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The current merge blocker is on the dashboard chrome surface most recently redesigned by steipete in merged PR 101497.
